name: Best Served Haute
source:
When your life falls apart, a stunning fashion designer offers you a fresh start... and a shot at revenge.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Best_Served_Haute]Choices Wikia[/url]]
